Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly identified the first place mentioned in the Book of Esther (NIV) as "Susa". In the New International Version, the very first verse (Esther 1:1) begins with "In the days of Ahasuerus, who reigned over one hundred twenty-seven provinces from India to Ethiopia," where the first proper noun/place name mentioned is "India" (referring to the Indus region or the land of India), not Susa. Susa appears later in the text (Esther 1:2). Because the location was identified incorrectly from the start, the subsequent search for the Prime Minister of Iran (the modern equivalent of Susa) instead of India led to a factually wrong answer for the specific question asked.
